meta.name: Inspector Nalinikanta
meta.description:
A meticulous murder of Sharmila Sen occurs days after her 15th marriage anniversary with renowned prosthetic surgeon Aditya Sen. Inspector Nalini Kundu takes the lead in the investigation and starts unfolding the mysteries.

Returning Series · First aired 19 Nov 2022 · ID · Language: Bengali

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

On your server — Audio: Bengali

videos.title: Belonging of Trophy Husband
videos.overview: Aditya belongs to whom? How will he restore his existence? What move does he take to answer against the allegations of his potential to be an ideal career holder?

videos.title: Don't Panic
videos.overview: A meticulous plan drawn and executed by Aditya against Sharmila. Meanwhile Nisha is suffering from constant panic. What's next waiting for Aditya?

videos.title: How Murder Looks Alike?
videos.overview: Investigation on the floor. The spiral of secrets is being revealed about Sharmila and Aditya. Meanwhile, Sharmila comes back from coma. Will she be able to identify the crime lead?

videos.title: Doppelganger
videos.overview: Investigating officer Nalini Kundu reveals the truth behind the mystery by connecting the dots with the existence of a doppelganger. Also throws doubt on the husband. What's next?

videos.title: Not A Regular Inspector
videos.overview: Here, the inspection takes place in more detail based on significant assumptions by Inspector Nalini Kundu and his assistant. The mild interrogation with Nisha leads towards unveiling the murder mystery and to the next target of doubt.

videos.title: Fear Faith
videos.overview: According to the pro-long investigation conspiracies behind the murder is getting simpler. While the main suspect trying hard to get away from the inspector, in the meantime inspector Nalini manages to manipulate Nisha against Dr. Sen.

videos.title: Cleaning Hand
videos.overview: Game changer Inspector Nalini created a chaos between Nisha and Dr. Sen and manages to win Nisha's trust. In the end when Nisha tries to run away police arrives and finally found the prime evidence against the murderer.
